datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly basis throughout 2012, classifying geographic areas by food insecurity phase. The spatial data was compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats representing current situation assessments for January, April, July, and October 2012.
